comparison.objective: Insert an SFP-ended fibre cable into a NIC port using both arms; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual keyed connector alignment and insertion versus key-driven unlocking, counterholding, collar rotation, retightening, and iterative impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Successful connector seating is implied; candidate requires two repeatable safe stops and verified lock retention. The record has no detailed seating, force, or damage rubric.
comparison.reason: Both involve alignment and bimanual work, but connector insertion does not test adjustable damping, calibrated iteration, or torque-retained settings.
